At first, I thought Indian food would be difficult for everyone.
Jul 2024 • Couples
I decided to choose a dish after researching information on the internet and the Masha Allah restaurant website. The first dish I chose was mix vegetables pakora. It was truly amazing; the taste was wonderful, aromatic, mildly spicy, and paired with the green chutney as they mentioned. For the main course, I ordered butter chicken curry. The colors were beautiful, and the flavor was rich, creamy, and fragrant with spices. And to my surprise, the garlic naan I ordered was quite large for just one person. It would probably take two people to finish it. The naan was fresh and fragrant, blending with the flavors of butter and garlic. Very delicious.
